sources.name: Specifying Systems
sources.description: Author-hosted book. Chapter 2 defines behaviors/specification; chapters 5 and 8 address invariance, implementation, liveness/fairness and refinement; chapter 14 addresses TLC model checking. Supports conceptual guidance, not a claim that this small helper implements TLA+.

sources.name: SMT-LIB language documentation
